name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-inbox
description: Contributes a workspace product to a repository that already has an application shell: microfrontend screens (contacts, dashboard, chat and mail) built from @gears-frontx/ui-kit, each with its own Module Federation build, route tree inside the shell's screen domain, UI strings, and mocked @gears-frontx/api services that share one mock dataset across the screens. Apply this onto template-shell to start a helpdesk, shared mailbox, contacts or metrics product; the screens appear in the shell's menu without further wiring.
